convention.text: A fact that the file does not mention is taken as not alleged, and the rules are applied as if it were absent. Silence never ends a process: where a fact's absence would end it, the unmentioned fact is unresolved. The defining event is never presumed: if the file does not mention it, it is unresolved. A fact that the file raises and leaves unsettled is open.
convention.applies_to: every branch fact of every type (value: false), except the defining event, a fact whose value false triggers a stop, and a fact marked always_stated
convention.precedence: a presumption a cited passage supports (under a type's presumptions) takes precedence; this rule set has none

types.title: Defect of the rented dwelling (mould, damp, heating)

facts.question: Does the claim state that the rented dwelling has a defect (for example mould, damp, or heating that fails) or that the tenant is disturbed in using the dwelling as agreed, without the claim itself saying that the tenant alone caused the defect or must remedy it at his own expense?
facts.not_this: A defect the claim itself attributes wholly to the tenant, or says he must remedy at his own expense, is no. A cause the claim calls shared or disputed is open, not no; a landlord's allegation that the tenant caused it, which the claim disputes, does not make this no.

facts.not_this: A landlord who learned of the defect from the caretaker, the property manager or an inspection, although the tenant never wrote: that landlord knows, so the answer is no.

rule.inference: A failure to notify is what the landlord raises (para. 2 attaches liability to it); the tenant's remedies turn on the landlord being aware of the defect (art. 259b), so a landlord who does not yet know is the exceptional case that removes the proof of the landlord's knowledge.

facts.not_this: A tenant who told the landlord by telephone and later confirmed it by letter, e-mail or text message: a written trace exists, so the answer is no.

rule.inference: The duty to inform prescribes no form (German: 'melden'), so the landlord may have been informed orally, and then no written proof of his knowledge can be produced.

facts.not_this: A reduction of the rent for the reduced use of the dwelling (art. 259d), which is not compensation for damage.

facts.not_this: Withholding or reducing the rent without paying it to a deposit office; the rental security paid at the start of the lease.

rule.passage: In addition, a tenant of immovable property may pay rent on deposit rather than to the landlord.

passage_de.passage: Der Mieter einer unbeweglichen Sache kann zudem den Mietzins hinterlegen.

types.title: Termination of the lease by the landlord

facts.question: Has the landlord given the tenant notice terminating the lease of the dwelling, and has it reached the tenant?
facts.not_this: No: only a file stating that no notice of termination has been given at all (also a lease of limited duration that simply ends on its agreed date, a termination only announced or threatened, a notice given by the tenant). A notice the landlord says was sent and the tenant says never reached him is open, not no.

rule.passage: A party wishing to challenge termination must bring the matter before the conciliation authority within 30 days of receiving the notice of termination.
rule.inference: The challenge and its 30-day period run from receipt of a notice of termination, so a received notice is the event that opens this type; disputed receipt leaves the event open.

passage_de.passage: Will eine Partei die Kündigung anfechten, so muss sie das Begehren innert 30 Tagen nach Empfang der Kündigung der Schlichtungsbehörde einreichen.

facts.question: Does the claim state that the tenant is married or in a registered partnership and that the rented dwelling serves as the family home?
facts.not_this: A tenant living with a partner who is neither spouse nor registered partner; spouses who do not use the dwelling as their family home.

rule.passage: Where the leased property serves as the family residence
rule.inference: Arts. 266m and 266n stand under the marginal heading 'Family residence' (Wohnung der Familie); art. 266m para. 1 states the condition, para. 3 extends it to registered partners, and art. 266n requires the landlord's notice to be served separately on the spouse or registered partner. The condition therefore is a family home of spouses or registered partners.

passage_de.passage: Dient die gemietete Sache als Wohnung der Familie

also.passage: The same provisions apply mutatis mutandis to registered partners.

passage_de.passage: Die gleiche Regelung gilt bei eingetragenen Partnerschaften sinngemäss.

also.passage: Notice of termination given by the landlord and any notification of a time limit for payment accompanied by a warning of termination in the event of non-payment (Art. 257d) must be served separately on the tenant and on his spouse or registered partner.

passage_de.passage: Die Kündigung durch den Vermieter sowie die Ansetzung einer Zahlungsfrist mit Kündigungsandrohung (Art. 257d) sind dem Mieter und seinem Ehegatten, seiner eingetragenen Partnerin oder seinem eingetragenen Partner separat zuzustellen.

facts.question: Does the notice or the claim state that the landlord terminated because the tenant did not pay overdue rent or accessory charges within a time limit the landlord had set?
facts.not_this: Arrears that the claim mentions while the notice is given for another reason (for example the landlord's own use); a dispute about a rent increase.

rule.passage: In the event of non-payment within the time limit the landlord or lessor may terminate the contract with immediate effect or, for leases of residential and commercial premises, subject to at least 30 days’ notice ending on the last day of a calendar month.

passage_de.passage: Bezahlt der Mieter innert der gesetzten Frist nicht, so kann der Vermieter fristlos, bei Wohn- und Geschäftsräumen mit einer Frist von mindestens 30 Tagen auf Ende eines Monats kündigen.

facts.question: Does the claim state that the landlord gave notice because the tenant had, in good faith, asserted claims under the lease (for example demanded repair of a defect or contested the rent)?
facts.not_this: Claims the tenant asserted that the claim does not connect with the notice; a notice the claim attributes to another reason, such as the landlord's own use.

rule.passage:
Notice of termination served by the landlord may be challenged in particular where it is given:
a. because the tenant is asserting claims arising under the lease in good faith;

passage_de.passage:
Die Kündigung durch den Vermieter ist insbesondere anfechtbar, wenn sie ausgesprochen wird:
a. weil der Mieter nach Treu und Glauben Ansprüche aus dem Mietverhältnis geltend macht;

facts.question: Does the tenant seek an extension of the lease because having to leave by the end date would be a hardship for the tenant or the tenant's family?
facts.not_this: A tenant who only contests the validity of the notice and does not ask for more time; a request for more time that the claim does not base on hardship.

rule.passage: The tenant may request the extension of a fixed-term or open-ended lease where termination of the lease would cause a degree of hardship for him or his family that cannot be justified by the interests of the landlord.

passage_de.passage: Der Mieter kann die Erstreckung eines befristeten oder unbefristeten Mietverhältnisses verlangen, wenn die Beendigung der Miete für ihn oder seine Familie eine Härte zur Folge hätte, die durch die Interessen des Vermieters nicht zu rechtfertigen wäre.

steps.title: Check the form of the notice, the notice period and the challenge deadline

rule.passage: Notice of termination is void if it does not conform to Articles 266l–266n.
rule.inference: A received notice is void if it does not conform to arts. 266l–266n, so its form and service are checked first.

passage_de.passage: Die Kündigung ist nichtig, wenn sie den Artikeln 266l–266n nicht entspricht.

steps.title: Check separate service on the spouse or registered partner

rule.passage: Notice of termination given by the landlord and any notification of a time limit for payment accompanied by a warning of termination in the event of non-payment (Art. 257d) must be served separately on the tenant and on his spouse or registered partner.
rule.inference: The passage states the duty of separate service; the family-home condition under which the step is reached comes from the marginal heading 'Family residence' and art. 266m para. 1 (see family_residence).

passage_de.passage: Die Kündigung durch den Vermieter sowie die Ansetzung einer Zahlungsfrist mit Kündigungsandrohung (Art. 257d) sind dem Mieter und seinem Ehegatten, seiner eingetragenen Partnerin oder seinem eingetragenen Partner separat zuzustellen.

steps.title: Check the payment time limit that preceded the notice and the payments made within it

rule.passage: Where, having accepted the property, the tenant or lessee is in arrears with payments of rent or accessory charges, the landlord or lessor may set a time limit for payment
rule.inference: A termination for arrears presupposes a time limit for payment set beforehand (in writing: 'schriftlich' in the German, missing from the English), so that time limit is checked.

passage_de.passage: Ist der Mieter nach der Übernahme der Sache mit der Zahlung fälliger Mietzinse oder Nebenkosten im Rückstand, so kann ihm der Vermieter schriftlich eine Zahlungsfrist setzen

steps.title: Check whether the notice can be challenged as contrary to good faith

rule.passage: Notice of termination may be challenged where it contravenes the principle of good faith.
rule.inference: Any received notice can be challenged on this ground, so the step is reached whenever a notice was received; the documents it needs depend on the grounds the claim states.

passage_de.passage: Die Kündigung ist anfechtbar, wenn sie gegen den Grundsatz von Treu und Glauben verstösst.

steps.title: Assess an extension of the lease

rule.passage:
No extension is granted where notice of termination is given:
a. because the tenant is in default on his payments (Art. 257d);
rule.inference: An extension can be at issue after any received notice, whether the tenant requests it or the authority examines it ex officio after rejecting a challenge (art. 273 para. 5); this passage excludes it where notice was given for arrears.

passage_de.passage:
Die Erstreckung ist ausgeschlossen bei Kündigungen:
a. wegen Zahlungsrückstand des Mieters (Art. 257d);

also.passage: Where the competent authority rejects a request made by the tenant relating to challenging termination, it must examine ex officio whether the lease may be extended.

passage_de.passage: Weist die zuständige Behörde ein Begehren des Mieters betreffend Anfechtung der Kündigung ab, so prüft sie von Amtes wegen, ob das Mietverhältnis erstreckt werden kann.

documents.title: Lease contract
must_show: agreed notice periods and termination dates

rule.passage: The parties may give notice to terminate a lease of indefinite duration by observing the legally prescribed notice periods and termination dates, except where they have agreed a longer notice period or a different termination date.
rule.inference: Whether the notice respects the notice period and termination date depends on what the parties agreed; the lease records the duration and any agreed periods and dates.

passage_de.passage: Die Parteien können das unbefristete Mietverhältnis unter Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Fristen und Termine kündigen, sofern sie keine längere Frist oder keinen anderen Termin vereinbart haben.

documents.title: Landlord's notice of termination
must_show: whether the form approved by the canton is used

rule.passage: The landlord must give notice of termination using a form approved by the canton which informs the tenant how he must proceed if he wishes to contest the termination or apply for an extension of the lease.
rule.inference: The landlord's notice must be given on a form approved by the canton (and in writing, art. 266l para. 1); only the notice itself shows whether it was.

passage_de.passage: Der Vermieter muss mit einem Formular kündigen, das vom Kanton genehmigt ist und das angibt, wie der Mieter vorzugehen hat, wenn er die Kündigung anfechten oder eine Erstreckung des Mietverhältnisses verlangen will.

also.passage: Notice to terminate leases of residential and commercial premises must be given in writing.

passage_de.passage: Vermieter und Mieter von Wohn- und Geschäftsräumen müssen schriftlich kündigen.

documents.title: Proof of the date the notice was received
must_show: how it was delivered (registered-mail tracking, envelope or acknowledgement)

rule.passage: A party wishing to challenge termination must bring the matter before the conciliation authority within 30 days of receiving the notice of termination.
rule.inference: The challenge must be brought within 30 days of receiving the notice; proof of the date of receipt is needed to check that period.

passage_de.passage: Will eine Partei die Kündigung anfechten, so muss sie das Begehren innert 30 Tagen nach Empfang der Kündigung der Schlichtungsbehörde einreichen.

documents.title: Proof of separate service on the spouse or registered partner (the spouse's own copy with envelope or tracking), or the spouse's statement that no separate copy was received
must_show: addressed to the spouse or registered partner
served separately from the tenant's copy
where the notice followed a payment time limit (art. 257d): the separately served copy of that time limit

rule.passage: Notice of termination given by the landlord and any notification of a time limit for payment accompanied by a warning of termination in the event of non-payment (Art. 257d) must be served separately on the tenant and on his spouse or registered partner.
rule.inference: Separate service on the spouse or registered partner is required (a notice that does not conform is void, art. 266o); the spouse's own copy ordinarily proves it was made, and the spouse's statement records that it was not.

passage_de.passage: Die Kündigung durch den Vermieter sowie die Ansetzung einer Zahlungsfrist mit Kündigungsandrohung (Art. 257d) sind dem Mieter und seinem Ehegatten, seiner eingetragenen Partnerin oder seinem eingetragenen Partner separat zuzustellen.

documents.title: Landlord's written payment time limit with warning of termination, and the tenant's record of payments made within it
must_show: time limit set and date it was received
warning that the lease will be terminated
payments made within the time limit (bank or postal records)

rule.passage: In the event of non-payment within the time limit the landlord or lessor may terminate the contract with immediate effect or, for leases of residential and commercial premises, subject to at least 30 days’ notice ending on the last day of a calendar month.
rule.inference: Termination is open to the landlord only after non-payment within the time limit; the landlord's written time limit shows the limit and the warning, and the tenant's payment records show whether payment was made within it.

passage_de.passage: Bezahlt der Mieter innert der gesetzten Frist nicht, so kann der Vermieter fristlos, bei Wohn- und Geschäftsräumen mit einer Frist von mindestens 30 Tagen auf Ende eines Monats kündigen.

documents.title: Correspondence on the tenant's claims and the landlord's reasons for the notice
must_show: claims the tenant asserted (for example a repair demand or a rent challenge), with dates
the reasons the landlord gave for the notice (on the notice, or given on request)
conciliation or court documents on those claims, if any

rule.passage:
Notice of termination served by the landlord may be challenged in particular where it is given:
a. because the tenant is asserting claims arising under the lease in good faith;
rule.inference: The notice may be challenged where it was given because the tenant asserted claims; the tenant's dated letters show which claims were asserted and when, and the landlord's stated reasons (which must be given on request, art. 271 para. 2) show the ground he relies on.

passage_de.passage:
Die Kündigung durch den Vermieter ist insbesondere anfechtbar, wenn sie ausgesprochen wird:
a. weil der Mieter nach Treu und Glauben Ansprüche aus dem Mietverhältnis geltend macht;

also.passage: On request, reasons for giving notice must be stated.

passage_de.passage: Die Kündigung muss auf Verlangen begründet werden.

documents.title: Evidence of the tenant's personal, family and financial circumstances

rule.passage: c. the personal, family and financial circumstances of the parties, as well as their conduct;
rule.inference: In weighing an extension the authority has particular regard to the parties' personal, family and financial circumstances; documents of the tenant's circumstances ordinarily prove them. They are requested where the tenant seeks an extension; an ex officio examination (art. 273 para. 5) does not by itself call for them.

passage_de.passage: c. die persönlichen, familiären und wirtschaftlichen Verhältnisse der Parteien und deren Verhalten;

rule.passage: A party wishing to challenge termination must bring the matter before the conciliation authority within 30 days of receiving the notice of termination.
rule.inference: The challenge runs from receipt of a notice of termination; where the claim states that the landlord gave no notice of termination there is nothing to challenge and the process ends. A notice whose receipt is disputed is open and does not stop. Not covered: a lease of limited duration ending without notice, where an extension may be requested under art. 273 para. 2 let. b; that is outside this type.

passage_de.passage: Will eine Partei die Kündigung anfechten, so muss sie das Begehren innert 30 Tagen nach Empfang der Kündigung der Schlichtungsbehörde einreichen.

facts.question: Does the claim state that the landlord has announced, demanded or charged a higher rent for the dwelling, by a notice, a letter, an invoice or otherwise (whether or not on an official form)?
facts.not_this: A landlord's plan to raise the rent that has not been announced, demanded or charged; the initial rent agreed for a new lease; new accessory charges or reduced services without a higher rent.

rule.passage:
The rent increase is void where:
a. it is not communicated using the prescribed form;
rule.inference: An increase not communicated on the prescribed form is void, so an increase the landlord applies or announces without a proper notice is still a rent-increase dispute; the type opens with any announced, demanded or charged increase.

passage_de.passage:
Die Mietzinserhöhung ist nichtig, wenn der Vermieter:
a. sie nicht mit dem vorgeschriebenen Formular mitteilt;

facts.question: Does the claim state that the increase is a step fixed in advance in the lease, by which the rent rises periodically by fixed amounts (graduated rent)?
facts.not_this: An increase under an index clause; an increase the lease does not fix in advance.

rule.passage: Without prejudice to the right to challenge the initial rent, the tenant may not challenge periodical rent increases.
rule.inference: A periodical increase agreed under art. 269c cannot be challenged as unfair, so the documents for testing unfairness are not needed; the agreement's validity and the notice remain to be checked.

passage_de.passage: Unter Vorbehalt der Anfechtung des Anfangsmietzinses kann der Mieter gestaffelte Mietzinse nicht anfechten.

facts.question: Does the claim state that the increase applies a clause of the lease linking the rent to an index (such as the Swiss consumer price index)?
facts.not_this: An increase the landlord justifies by general inflation or by cost increases without an index clause in the lease.

rule.passage: Without prejudice to the right to challenge the initial rent, a party may argue before the conciliation authority only that the rent increase or reduction requested by the other party is not justified by a corresponding change in the index.
rule.inference: Under an index clause the only argument is whether the index changed correspondingly, so documents of cost increases are not needed.

passage_de.passage: Unter Vorbehalt der Anfechtung des Anfangsmietzinses kann eine Partei vor der Schlichtungsbehörde nur geltend machen, dass die von der andern Partei verlangte Erhöhung oder Herabsetzung des Mietzinses durch keine entsprechende Änderung des Indexes gerechtfertigt sei.

facts.question: Does the increase notice give, as its reason, higher costs for the landlord (for example higher mortgage interest or operating costs) or additional services or works by the landlord (for example a renovation)?
facts.not_this: An increase justified only by rents customary in the locality (art. 269a let. a) or by inflation on the risk capital (art. 269a let. e).

rule.passage: b. they are justified by increases in costs or by additional services provided by the landlord;
rule.inference: Where the notice relies on cost increases or additional services, whether the increase is justified by them bears on whether it is unfair (art. 269a: 'in general' not unfair, German 'in der Regel'). Always stated: an increase notice must give reasons (art. 269d para. 1), and cost reasons and other reasons (such as local customary rents, art. 269a let. a) are both ordinary, so neither is a default.

passage_de.passage: b. durch Kostensteigerungen oder Mehrleistungen des Vermieters begründet sind;

facts.question: Does the claim state that, together with the rent increase, the landlord gave notice of termination?
facts.not_this: A threat of termination without a notice of termination (it shows on the increase notice or its covering letter, which is requested anyway); a notice of termination given separately at another time.

rule.passage: c. notice of the increase is accompanied by notice to terminate or a threat of termination.
rule.inference: The passage voids an increase accompanied by a notice or a threat of termination; this fact covers the notice only, because only a notice is a separate document to request (a threat is read from the increase notice).

passage_de.passage: c. mit der Mitteilung die Kündigung androht oder ausspricht.

steps.title: Check the form, reasons and timing of the increase

rule.passage: He must give notice of and reasons for the rent increase at least ten days before the beginning of the notice period for termination using a form approved by the canton.
rule.inference: An increase must be notified with reasons, in time and on the approved form, so these are checked first; for a graduated-rent step, written form suffices instead of the form (art. 269d para. 5).

passage_de.passage: Er muss dem Mieter die Mietzinserhöhung mindestens zehn Tage vor Beginn der Kündigungsfrist auf einem vom Kanton genehmigten Formular mitteilen und begründen.

also.passage: In the case of a rent increase in accordance with an agreement under Article 269c, it is sufficient that notice be given in writing.

passage_de.passage: Für die Mitteilung von Mietzinserhöhungen, die in einer Vereinbarung nach Artikel 269c vorgesehen sind, genügt die schriftliche Form.

rule.passage:
An agreement to increase the rent periodically by fixed amounts is valid only where:
a. the lease is contracted for at least three years;
b. the rent is increased no more than once a year; and
c. the amount by which it is increased is fixed in francs.

passage_de.passage:
Die Vereinbarung, dass sich der Mietzins periodisch um einen bestimmten Betrag erhöht, ist nur gültig, wenn:
a. der Mietvertrag für mindestens drei Jahre abgeschlossen wird;
b. der Mietzins höchstens einmal jährlich erhöht wird; und
c. der Betrag der Erhöhung in Franken festgelegt wird.

rule.passage: An agreement to link rent to an index is valid only where the lease is contracted for at least five years and the benchmark is the Swiss consumer prices index.

passage_de.passage: Die Vereinbarung, dass der Mietzins einem Index folgt, ist nur gültig, wenn der Mietvertrag für mindestens fünf Jahre abgeschlossen und als Index der Landesindex der Konsumentenpreise vorgesehen wird.

steps.title: Check whether the increase is justified by its stated reasons

rule.passage: Within 30 days of receiving notice of a rent increase, the tenant may challenge it before the conciliation authority as unfair within the meaning of Articles 269 and 269a.
rule.inference: An increase that is neither a graduated step (art. 270d) nor index-linked (art. 270c) can be challenged as unfair under arts. 269 and 269a, so its reasons are tested.

passage_de.passage: Der Mieter kann eine Mietzinserhöhung innert 30 Tagen, nachdem sie ihm mitgeteilt worden ist, bei der Schlichtungsbehörde als missbräuchlich im Sinne der Artikel 269 und 269a anfechten.

steps.title: Check the notice of termination given with the increase

rule.passage: c. notice of the increase is accompanied by notice to terminate or a threat of termination.

rule.passage: The landlord may at any time increase the rent with effect from the next termination date.
rule.inference: The increase can take effect only from the next termination date; the lease records the termination dates (and any graduated-rent or index clause, arts. 269b–269c).

passage_de.passage: Der Vermieter kann den Mietzins jederzeit auf den nächstmöglichen Kündigungstermin erhöhen.
